correctness.rationale: For positive D,L,r and interior asymmetry, the bilateral Laplace resolvent of Brownian motion sampled at an exponential time gives the exact two geometric tails of the completed-cycle lattice jump. The mean LM and second moment L²S follow by tail summation. The regenerative variance rate is r E[(J-r E[J]T)^2]/2, not r Var(J)/2: differentiating E[J](r) gives E[JT]=E[J]/r-E[J] prime(r), yielding the stated negative clock-correction r² E[J] E[J] prime(r). The monotonicity of z coth z shows M M_ell<0 away from δ=1/2. Small-ell expansions give 1+[1/24+(δ-1/2)^2/2]ell²+O(ell⁴), and exponential tails give high-rate decay, ensuring existence (not uniqueness) of a finite optimum. Uniformly bounded unfinished-cycle second moment makes its variance contribution o(t). Independently evaluated δ=1/4,ell=8 as 1.9348075430624287; this finite test corroborates but does not prove the all-parameter result.
